intro: Public home and workspace-authorized request examples.
localeError: Preferred language is unavailable; the current language has been retained.
loginDescription: Sign in with a public synthetic demo account.
loginError: Sign-in failed. Check your account and retry.
system.demoNotice: Process-memory demo data resets on service restart. Records are independent of the fixed synthetic sign-in accounts and authorization directory; these pages do not manage production identities or organizations.
system.deleteDescription: Deletion cannot be undone. References or child records prevent deletion.
system.draftAvailable: An unsaved draft exists for this record. Choose whether to restore or discard it.
system.writeUnavailable: Authorization or reference data is not ready. Saving is unavailable; your input is retained.
system.lookupFailed: Reference data could not be loaded. Please retry.
system.reconfirmWrite: Your session recovered and input is retained. Confirm saving again; this write was not retried automatically.
system.reconfirmDelete: Your session recovered. Click Delete and confirm again; this deletion was not retried automatically.
system.writeForbidden: This account cannot write. Your input is retained.
system.recordMissing: This record no longer exists. Reload the list.
system.conflict: The record conflicts with existing data or is still referenced. Check and retry.
system.invalidRequest: The submitted data is invalid. Check the fields.
system.requestFailed: The request failed. Please retry; unsaved input is retained.
system.invalidCode: Use 2–64 lowercase letters, digits, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a lowercase letter.
system.invalidOrder: Order must be an integer from 0 to 9999 and cannot be blank.
system.invalidHref: Enter a safe HTTP(S) or same-origin relative URL.
system.field.name: Name
system.field.title: Title
transfer.title: Upload and download
transfer.description: Demo files live only in the mock process and reset on restart. Progress counts bytes acknowledged by the server.
transfer.cancelled: Upload stopped; this does not confirm a server rollback.
transfer.failed: Upload failed. Check the file and retry.
transfer.reconfirm: The session was restored. Confirm upload again; the write was not retried automatically.
transfer.unavailable: Authorization is not ready for file transfers.
transfer.limit: Demo files are limited to 1 MiB.
